phone.scanQr: Scan the QR code on the big screen to join the game.
phone.pickEdge: Tap the edge of the tile that should touch the map, or use All positions.
phone.pickSpot: Pick the number of a position.
phone.noSpots: The tile cannot be placed with that edge connected.
phone.pickFeature: Tap the part of the tile where the figure should stand.
phone.exchangeHint: None of your tiles fit anywhere. Swap one for a new tile.
phone.padHint: Touchpad: drag to move the map, pinch to zoom, twist to rotate, tap to select an area.
phone.pickTile: Tap the tile you want to play.
rules.title: Rules
phone.statsOnScreen: The statistics are shown on the big screen.
start.unreadable: Cannot be read (saved by another version)
help.phase.chooseTile: Choose which of your tiles to play. If none of them can be placed anywhere, you may swap one for a new tile from the stack.
help.phase.placeTile: Place the tile. Tap the edge of the tile that should touch the map, then the number of a position. You can also pick All positions. The tile must fit its neighbours on every side.
help.phase.placeFigure: You may place one figure on the tile you just placed, on a part that no one else already has a figure in. Tap the part, then the figure. You may also skip it.
help.phase.confirm: Check your move. Tap Confirm move to finish your turn, or Undo to go back one step.
help.phase.other: Follow the choices shown on your phone. Undo takes back the last step, and nothing is final until you confirm the move.
help.expansion.river: The River: the river tiles are laid first, and each new river tile must continue the river without turning back on itself. Until the lake is placed, players only hold river tiles.
help.expansion.abbot: The Abbot: instead of a normal figure you may place your abbot on a garden or a monastery, or take your abbot back from the board to score its points.
help.expansion.inns-cathedrals: Inns & Cathedrals: a completed road with an inn scores 2 points per tile, and a completed city with a cathedral 3 per tile and pennant, but both score nothing if unfinished at the end. The large follower counts as two followers when deciding who wins a feature, but does not double the points.
help.expansion.traders-builders: Traders & Builders: whoever completes a city takes its trade goods. At the end, most of each good scores 10 points (ties all score 10). Your builder joins a road or city where you have a follower; extending it gives you an extra turn. Your pig joins a field where you have a farmer and makes it score 4 instead of 3 per completed city.
